classification_definitions.CONTAINS_PRIVATE_PATH_BUT_ACCEPTABLE_INT: Immutable internal provenance containing machine paths but no credential.
classification_definitions.CONTAINS_SECRET_DO_NOT_INCLUDE: Artifact contains actual-looking authentication material and must be omitted without being silently represented as original.
classification_definitions.SAFE_AND_SCIENTIFICALLY_RELEVANT: Safe artifact retained because it supports scientific reconstruction, execution provenance, or auditability.
classification_definitions.SAFE_BUT_OPTIONAL: Safe artifact with contextual rather than claim-essential value.
classification_definitions.UNNECESSARY_DEVELOPMENT_ARTIFACT: Development-only material not needed for the archival snapshot.

generated_report_self_exclusion_reason: Repository-generated scan reports are excluded from their own per-file hash table to avoid self-referential hashes; both are covered by the final pre-staging secret and history scan.
scope: Vetted provenance-heavy artifacts in the clean archival snapshot
